title: Data Analyst
description: Transform raw corporate data into actionable business intelligence, interactive executive dashboards, and statistical decision frameworks.

goal.objective: Empower leadership and product teams with actionable insights, interactive visual reports, and data-backed business recommendations.

learn.summary: Master intermediate to advanced SQL, Power BI / Tableau dashboard engineering, Excel financial modeling, basic Python data wrangling, and metric storytelling.
key_competencies: Advanced Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, Power Query)
Business Metric Definition (CAC, LTV, Retention, Funnels)

capstone_projects.title: Executive SaaS Growth & Cohort Retention Dashboard
capstone_projects.description: Build an interactive executive cockpit analyzing user acquisition funnels, cohort retention curves, and monthly recurring revenue (MRR).

capstone_projects.title: Customer Churn Predictive Pipeline & Cohort Model
capstone_projects.description: Analyze longitudinal subscriber telemetry, execute cohort retention analysis, build an actionable churn propensity classifier, and visualize business impact for stakeholders.

certifications: Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300)
interview_focus: Effective Stakeholder Presentation of Data Insights

tree.name: Foundational Data Concepts & Spreadsheet Mastery
tree.description: Establish an unshakeable analytical foundation: master structured business problem solving, advanced financial and operational spreadsheet modeling, and data ethics governance.

resources.title: COMPLETE Data Analytics Portfolio Project in 6 EASY Steps | Python + SQL + Power BI
Excel for Data Analysis - Full Course

children.name: Business Acumen & Analytical Problem Solving
children.description: Master structured hypothesis-driven problem solving: constructing Mutually Exclusive and Collectively Exhaustive (MECE) issue trees, translating ambiguous business challenges into quantifiable analytical hypotheses, and mapping KPI metric trees.

resources.title: Business Intelligence Full Course | Business Intelligence Tutorial for Beginners | Data Analyst Course

children.name: Excel/Google Sheets for Advanced Data Analysis
children.description: Master advanced spreadsheet modeling for enterprise analysis: nested `XLOOKUP` and dynamic array formulas (`FILTER`, `SORT`, `UNIQUE`), Power Query (M) data shaping, multi-table Pivot Tables using the Excel Data Model, and sensitivity scenario modeling.

resources.title: Excel Full Course - Learn Excel in 4 Hours
Excel Power Query Tutorial for Beginners - Full Course

children.name: Introduction to Data Types and Structures
children.description: Understand data formats and types: discrete vs continuous variables, nominal, ordinal, interval, and ratio scales, and managing missingness, anomalies, and structural integrity in analytical datasets.

resources.title: pandas Data Structures: Series and DataFrame
Data Analysis with Python - Full Course for Beginners (Numpy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn)

children.name: Data Ethics, Privacy & Governance Basics
children.description: Adhere to data ethics and privacy standards: anonymization and aggregation techniques, identifying sampling and algorithmic bias, and complying with regulatory standards (GDPR, CCPA) regarding customer PII.

resources.title: Data Privacy & Ethics for Data Science
What is Data Governance? Explained in 3 Minutes

children.name: Introduction to Data Warehousing & OLAP Concepts
children.description: Understand analytical data warehouse architectures: differences between transactional databases (OLTP) and analytical warehouses (OLAP), star schemas, fact tables, dimension tables, and cloud warehouse concepts (Snowflake, BigQuery).

resources.title: Online Analytical Processing and OLAP Cubes (AWS)
Data Warehouse Tutorial For Beginners | Data Warehouse Concepts

tree.name: Relational Databases, Statistics & Scripting with Python
tree.description: Master the core analytical engine: advanced SQL querying, inferential statistics, exploratory data analysis with Python, and reproducible version control.

resources.title: SQL Tutorial - Full Database Course for Beginners
Complete Python Pandas Data Science Tutorial! (Reading CSV/Excel files, filtering, grouping, etc.)

children.name: Advanced SQL for Data Querying & Performance
children.description: Master advanced analytical SQL: window functions (`DENSE_RANK`, `LEAD`, `LAG`, rolling moving averages with `ROWS BETWEEN`), cohort retention matrices, multi-step customer funnel drop-off analysis, user sessionization, and query execution plan optimization.

resources.title: Advanced SQL Tutorial | The Ultimate Guide (for Data Analysis, Data Science, and Analytics)

children.name: Statistical Foundations for Data-Driven Decisions
children.description: Master inferential statistics for decision making: probability distributions, central limit theorem, hypothesis testing (two-sample t-tests, ANOVA, Chi-square tests), statistical significance ($p$-values), confidence intervals, and rigorous A/B testing design (sample size calculation, statistical power, MDE).

resources.title: Statistics for Data Science | Full Course

children.name: Python for Data Manipulation, EDA & Basic Automation
children.description: Perform deep Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) in Python: data cleaning and aggregation with Pandas 2.0 and Polars, vectorized transformations, multivariate statistical charting with Seaborn, and interactive visual exploration with Plotly.

resources.title: Data Analysis with Python - Full Course for Beginners (Numpy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn)

children.name: Version Control with Git and GitHub Basics
children.description: Implement disciplined version control for analytical code: managing Jupyter Notebooks and SQL repositories with Git, commit discipline, branching strategies, and collaborative peer code review.

resources.title: Git and GitHub for Versioning Data Science Projects
Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course

children.name: Practical Project: SQL & Python Data Analysis Sprint
children.description: Analytics Sprint Project: perform end-to-end customer churn analysis using SQL data extraction and Python statistical modeling, identifying significant behavioral drivers and presenting findings in an analytical report.

resources.title: COMPLETE Data Analytics Portfolio Project in 6 EASY Steps | Python + SQL + Power BI

tree.name: Data Visualization, Storytelling & Business Intelligence
tree.description: Master visual data communication, modern Business Intelligence dashboards, and executive data storytelling.

Data Analysis with Python - Full Course for Beginners (Numpy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn)

children.name: Principles of Effective Data Visualization
children.description: Apply cognitive science and design principles to data visualization: Gestalt principles of visual perception, pre-attentive visual attributes (color, size, orientation), maximizing data-ink ratio, and avoiding misleading axes and distorted scales.

resources.title: Fundamentals of Data Visualization (Claus O. Wilke)
Data Visualization Best Practices with Examples
Data Visualization with D3.js - Full Tutorial Course

children.name: BI Tools: Data Modeling, Dashboard Design & Advanced Features
children.description: Master enterprise BI platforms (Power BI / Tableau): building robust star schema data models, writing DAX measures (`CALCULATE`, time intelligence) or Tableau Level of Detail (LOD) expressions, report page tooltips, and interactive drill-through paths.

resources.title: Learn Power BI in 7 Hours | Full Beginner to Advanced Course with Dashboard Project (2025)

children.name: Cloud Data Platforms Overview (AWS, Azure, GCP)
children.description: Query modern cloud analytical platforms: querying enterprise datasets in Snowflake and Google BigQuery, leveraging partitioned tables, and connecting cloud warehouses directly to BI dashboards.

children.name: Advanced Data Storytelling & Executive Presentation
children.description: Craft persuasive executive data narratives: structuring presentations using the Minto Pyramid Principle (Lead with the Recommendation), contextualizing data insights with business financial impact, and driving stakeholder action.
